title: 多模态调用成本模型：视觉 token + 文本 token
code:
VISION_PRICE = 0.01
TEXT_PRICE = 0.0005
n_images = 5
n_text_tokens = 2000
cost = n_images * VISION_PRICE + (n_text_tokens/1000) * TEXT_PRICE
print(f"图像数: {n_images} × ${VISION_PRICE} = ${n_images*VISION_PRICE:.2f}")
print(f"文本: {n_text_tokens} tokens × ${TEXT_PRICE}/1k = ${(n_text_tokens/1000)*TEXT_PRICE:.4f}")
print(f"单次调用成本: ${cost:.4f}")
